python_model: Tested pilot; not a validated Bangladesh motorised-routing model or AccessMod 5 equivalent

friction.label: Motorised travel-cost grid and documented transport assumptions
friction.note: File presence and provenance approval are necessary; grid/model validation still required.

population.label: BBS spatial population counts aligned to the analysis grid
population.note: File presence and provenance approval are necessary; grid/model validation still required.

capacity.label: DGHS service capacity in persons per declared period
capacity.note: File presence and provenance approval are necessary; grid/model validation still required.

candidates.label: Feasible candidate sites, proposed capacity and site budget
candidates.note: File presence and provenance approval are necessary; grid/model validation still required.

analyses.label: Travel-time accessibility
analyses.question: Time to the nearest facility; facilities reachable within each threshold, separately by DGHS tier.
analyses.outputs: Travel-time map, threshold maps, travel-time distribution, facility-option counts and tables.
analyses.note: Input readiness does not certify an analysis run. No AccessMod 5 or Bangladesh model result exists for this module.

analyses.label: Capacity-constrained geographic coverage
analyses.question: People allocated service capacity, and physically accessible people left unserved.
analyses.outputs: Served/unserved maps, capacity-allocation chart and facility/population tables.
analyses.note: Input readiness does not certify an analysis run. No AccessMod 5 or Bangladesh model result exists for this module.

analyses.label: Referral analysis
analyses.question: Travel time and distance between selected facility tiers along modelled routes.
analyses.outputs: Referral-route maps, time/distance distributions and origin–destination tables.
analyses.note: Input readiness does not certify an analysis run. No AccessMod 5 or Bangladesh model result exists for this module.

analyses.label: Population coverage by administrative area
analyses.question: Percentage of BBS population within 30, 60 and 120 minutes in each available administrative area.
analyses.outputs: Population-coverage choropleths, threshold comparison charts and zonal tables.
analyses.note: Input readiness does not certify an analysis run. No AccessMod 5 or Bangladesh model result exists for this module.

analyses.label: New-facility location optimisation
analyses.question: Choose sites that maximise additional population served within the declared candidate set and budget.
analyses.outputs: Selected-site maps, additional-people-served charts, scenarios and solver optimality status.
analyses.note: Input readiness does not certify an analysis run. No AccessMod 5 or Bangladesh model result exists for this module.

union.note: Bd_union.zip is actually ADM3 (544 upazila/thana areas); it is not used as a union layer.

boundaries.note: The file called Bd_union.zip contains ADM3 upazila/thana areas. ADM4 union results are not available.

facility_coordinates_note: DGHS location gaps and name–point disagreements require review before policy use. A point location does not establish a usable road entrance.

Comparison with observed motorised journey times
population_note: Division totals cannot establish population covered at travel-time thresholds; no uniform population distribution is assumed.
